item.title: A legacy fulfilled: Lisa Macuja Elizalde marks 40th homecoming celebration with a season of curated performances and a landmark collaboration with The Dawn
item.description: Exactly forty years ago, Lisa Macuja Elizalde made the defining choice to leave behind a flourishing career at the Kirov Ballet (now Mariinksy Ballet) in Moscow and return to the Philippines. That homecoming became the cornerstone of her mission to bring ballet to the people and people to ballet, a mission that has shaped generations of dancers and audiences.

item.title: Gong cha Chinese New Year Promo: 50% OFF Drinks
item.description: Gong cha is making Chinese New Year extra lucky! Enjoy 50% OFF on selected Medium drinks! Available at selected branches only, this festive promo is the perfect way to sip, save, and celebrate prosperity.

item.description: Pizza lovers, get ready to indulge without breaking the bank! Enjoy a 40% OFF weekday treat at Pizza Hut when you pay with your BDO Credit Card. Whether you’re dining in with friends or grabbing take-out for the family, this exclusive deal makes every bite more satisfying.

item.title: Krispy Kreme CNY Promo: Free Lucky Charm Doughnuts
item.description: Welcome the Lunar New Year the Krispy Kreme way! ✨Krispy Kreme is welcoming the Chinese New Year with a delicious treat! item.description: If upgrading your home has been on your 2026 vision board, now’s the perfect time to make it happen. item.title: Celebrate Chinese New Year 2026: 2 Pearl Milk Teas for ₱26 with BPI & Chatime!
item.description: Celebrate Chinese New Year 2026 with a sweet surprise from BPI and Chatime! 🐴🏮Ring in the Year of the Horse with a bigger and better treat—get 2 Regular Pearl Milk Teas for only ₱26 when you pay via QR using your BPI app at any Chatime store nationwide. item.title: Conrad Manila Presents: Brasserie on 3 — Global Flavors at Half the Price!
item.description: Indulge in the art of refined dining at Brasserie on 3, where globally inspired flavors are masterfully curated by Executive Chef Nicolas de Visch. BDO Elite cardholders enjoy an exclusive 50% off on lunch and dinner buffet—available daily.

item.title: CHAGEE Store Opening in the Philippines Grand Opening Promos, Exclusive Deals & Merch
item.description: CHAGEE continues to expand across the Philippines, bringing its premium tea experience to more communities nationwide. 💙 Known as the “Dior of Milk Tea Chains,” CHAGEE crafts authentic drinks using whole tea leaves—never artificial flavors—delivering rich taste in every sip.
